experiment: DCF-16 verifier-grounded curriculum of computational decisions
heldout_rule: star, dense, hyper, ktree, xor_noiseless and weak_dense never appear in train or val; chain, grid and sparse appear in heldout only at sizes 48 and 64 (train/val stop at 32), with fresh seeds
selection_label: option maximising expected utility under the verified reference posterior minus lambda * ops / budget among operators within budget (ties -> abstain); exact option resolved to the cheapest exact operator
verification: each example's reference posterior was accepted only when an independent exact path agreed within 1e-8 (DCF-14 run_instance); verify re-derives the posterior from the serialised problem
contamination: sha256 of the canonical problem (scopes, kinds, observations, noise, query) must not repeat across splits
